name: Venalthumbikal
englishSubtitle: Summer Dragonflies — Children's Traveling Cultural Theater
description: Kerala's largest traveling children's theater troupe, touring thousands of rural and urban localities with original street plays, folk songs, rhythmic dances, and puppetry dedicated to child rights, environmental conservation, and social equality.

name: Venal Kalari
englishSubtitle: Vacation Creative and Folk Arts Camps
description: Residential and day workshop camps training school children in theater arts, clay sculpture, folk rhythms, creative writing, public discourse, and indigenous cultural forms, fostering personality growth without commercial pressures.

name: Kilikkoodu
description: The official children's magazine published by Balasangham, presenting creative writing, scientific features, nature columns, world affairs, and artwork submitted by child members across 20,000 neighborhood units.

name: Shasthra Deepthi & Nature Camps
description: Educational drives aimed at cultivating scientific inquiry and rational thought through night sky observation with telescopes, hands-on scientific experiments debunking superstitious claims, biodiversity mapping, and local waterbody restoration drives.

name: Kutti Koottams & Reading Clubs
description: Weekly neighborhood gatherings in rural and urban wards where child members manage book borrowing, conduct group storytelling, review current affairs, and make collective decisions on local initiatives.

name: Anti-Substance & Child Safety Vigilance
description: Mass mobilization of children, parents, and teachers through massive human chains, street theater, flash mobs, and neighborhood vigils to protect young minds from narcotics and digital exploitation.
